scenario_name: Agent avoids Phase 3 questions in first interaction
expected_behavior: Agent asks about party size, occasion, preferences — all Phase 1 and 2 topics. Does NOT ask about gaming budget, comp expectations, loyalty status, or how much they typically spend. Those questions are too early for a first-time guest
expected_behavioral_quality: In a first interaction, the agent NEVER asks Phase 3 questions (relationship-level: gaming budget, comp history, host relationship, personal financial signals). These feel invasive before trust is established. The agent stays in Phase 1 (foundation) and Phase 2 (preferences) only.

turns.user_message: First time here, what do you recommend?
turns.agent_response:
Welcome to Mohegan Sun. You're in great hands, so take your time getting acclimated. I'd suggest starting at the Wolf Den in the center of Casino of the Earth—it’s an intimate spot for free live music, and there's a show tonight at 8:00 PM. It’s the best way to soak in the atmosphere without any pressure. 

Did you have a long drive to get here, or are you visiting from nearby?

The Wolf Den is the heart of the property tonight, offering free live music right in the center of the action. If you want a break from the floor, the Elemis Spa is the perfect reset—their hot stone massage is legendary. For something completely different, we have an indoor climbing wall called Wombi Rock that’s a fun way to see the resort from a new perspective. 

Are you looking for a high-energy night out or more of a relaxing getaway?

For a standout dinner, Ballo Italian Restaurant over in Casino of the Sky is my top pick. The aroma of their housemade pasta and risotto hits you right when you walk in, and it is a fantastic modern take on traditional Italian. 

They open at 5:00 PM, which gives you plenty of time to explore a bit before grabbing a table. How many people are in your group tonight?
